scope: Independent read-only review of the new failed-resource exporter and its fixture evidence; no tests, inventory, GPU queries or training were executed by this reviewer.

checks.strict_finalizer_unchanged: SHA256 matches the preceding independent final-delivery review. No strict acceptance gate was weakened.
checks.sole_root_failure: Reuses strict completion_evidence, verify_processes and verify_gpu_history. Requires all formal B/C/checkpoint/baseline/watcher completion, inactive exact task PIDs, physical GPU 1 UUID/history, integer GPU memory below 2048 MiB, and no exact recorded task compute PID. Original limit must equal 300000000, and raw current-used minus original-baseline-used must be strictly above it.
checks.before_and_after_inventory: All non-root gates run before inventory; completion, PID evidence, GPU history, baseline and machine snapshot are independently rechecked after inventory. Root recovery to or below the original limit blocks all new publication. GPU/PID/history/completion changes also block.
checks.inventory_stability: Uses unchanged exhaustive freeze_inventory with full file hashes, actual JSONL line counts, file-set/stat stability checks and symlink/unfinished-artifact rejection.
checks.failure_publication: Writes failed resource evidence first, with root_limit_passed=false and no subtraction; manifest complete=true means exhaustive inventory only and also carries task/resource acceptance failed. An I/O failure may leave only the new failed receipt, never a new manifest paired with a stale successful receipt.
checks.exit_status: Successful failed-evidence export returns code 1 with export_complete=true and status=failed. Rejected export returns code 1 with export_complete=false. Invalid invocation may be rejected by argparse before export.
checks.report_compatibility: Existing report retains all complete strategy metrics and checkpoint selection while root flags/raw delta keep its overall status failed. Existing checksums code accepts the complete file inventory and verifies coverage/hashes independently of acceptance status.
checks.fixture_evidence: Read the 26-case passing XML and source. Fixtures cover non-root failures, root boundaries/recovery, post-inventory mutations, repeated export, unrelated reused PIDs, report/checksum compatibility and CLI return status. Autouse fixture blocks subprocess.check_output and mocks process snapshots. Original 13 failed fixtures from the mock signature error remain archived.

delivery_notes: This is a failure-evidence export path, not a finalizer success path. Real execution remains deferred until all B/C and watcher processes have completed and actual GPU release is proven.

On this branch, exporter exit 1 and report build exit 1 are expected only when JSON/failed resource evidence establishes the intended raw-root failure. Inspect export_complete and failure reasons explicitly, then generate the plot and rebuild the report without changing failed acceptance to complete. Avoid && chains that suppress delivery artifacts on the expected nonzero result.
If root growth recovers to at most 300000000 bytes, use the unchanged strict finalizer instead; do not export a fabricated root failure.
No actual terminal resource measurements or acceptance results are asserted by this review.
